Notes
Full-Time and Part-Time Spa Therapists

Exciting opportunities have arisen for qualified Therapists to join our professional wellness and holistic Therapist Team at Brightlife Spa.

As we prepare to open our new Spa Garden and welcome more guests, we are expanding our team and are seeking both full-time and part-time therapists who share our commitment to exceptional treatments, outstanding guest care and holistic well-being.

Our Spa offers a range of indulgent treatments and wellness facilities within a serene and tranquil setting. Our therapies take a holistic approach, focusing on each guest as an individual and supporting their overall physical, mental and emotional well-being. We aim to provide every guest with a deeply relaxing, personalised and memorable experience.

The Role
As a Spa Therapist, you will play an important role in delivering exceptional treatments and ensuring the comfort and well-being of our guests throughout their visit.
Your responsibilities will include:
Performing a variety of spa treatments, including massage, facials, body treatments and other holistic wellness therapies.
Assessing each guest’s individual needs and tailoring treatments accordingly.
Providing knowledgeable and appropriate treatment and aftercare recommendations.
Delivering consistently high standards of guest care and professionalism.
Maintaining excellent standards of hygiene, cleanliness and presentation within treatment rooms and communal areas.
Working collaboratively with other members of the spa team to create a harmonious and efficient working environment.

Full training will be provided in our complete range of treatments and treatment protocols.

Qualifications and Attributes
Applicants should:
Hold an NVQ Level 3 qualification, or equivalent, in beauty therapy and massage.
Have excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
Demonstrate a genuine interest in holistic therapies, wellness and guest care.
Be able to work confidently both independently and as part of a team.
Have a positive, friendly and professional manner.
Be reliable, well-presented and committed to maintaining high standards.

What We Offer
Full in-house training in our treatment range and protocols.
Full uniform.
Competitive rates of pay.
A beautiful and supportive working environment.
The opportunity to become part of an established spa as it enters an exciting period of growth.

Both full-time and part-time positions are available. Working hours will include a combination of daytime, evening and weekend shifts.

How to Apply
To apply, please email your CV and a covering letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience to julie.watson@brightlife.com.

We’re looking for a reliable, hardworking and detail-focused Cleaner & Housekeeping assistant to help maintain our premises to the highest standard.
You’ll need to be: organised, thorough, self-motivated and take pride in creating immaculate spaces; someone who notices the little details and enjoys delivering an exceptional guest experience. The role is active and hands-on, involving regular manual handling, carrying laundry and supplies, and working across multiple floors using stairs.
The main aspect of the role covers maintaining our public areas and supporting the smooth day-to-day operation with early morning shifts. Additional duties include the daily checks and turnovers of suites and replenishing amenities. The role can be made flexible for the right candidate.
A brilliant opportunity for someone who values high standards and wants to be part of a quality island venue.

Notes
Hartford Homes is seeking an experienced Quantity Surveyor to join our award-winning team and help uphold our unrivalled reputation for building exceptional quality homes across the Isle of Man. This is a key full-time role within the business, with responsibility for the commercial management of residential developments from inception through to completion.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing project budgets, cost plans, forecasts and cash flow, while preparing valuations, variations and final accounts. They will procure and manage subcontractor packages, monitor costs, identify commercial risks and opportunities, and produce accurate monthly commercial reports and cost reconciliations. The role also involves managing contractual matters, maintaining comprehensive commercial records, and working closely with site teams to support the successful delivery of projects. Regular liaison with subcontractors, suppliers and consultants will be essential to ensure effective communication and collaboration throughout each development.

Applicants should have proven experience as a Quantity Surveyor within the construction or housebuilding industry, supported by strong commercial awareness and cost management skills. Experience in subcontractor procurement and account management, together with a sound understanding of construction contracts and contractual procedures, is essential. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication and relationship-building skills, enabling them to work effectively with both site and office teams. They will be organised, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities, while also having the confidence to communicate tactfully and challenge constructively when required. Competence in Microsoft Excel, a full driving licence, and a commitment to maintaining and fostering strong teamwork are also key requirements for this role.

TO APPLY: Please send your CV and cover letter by email jobs@hartford.im or post Hartford Homes, Middle River, Douglas, IM2 1AL.

Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Enforce the Laws of the Game:
Apply the IFAB Laws of the Game fairly, consistently, and impartially throughout the match.

Ensure Player Safety:
Protect players by penalising dangerous play, managing physical contact, and stopping play for injuries when required.

Control and Manage the Match:
Maintain discipline, manage tempo, and deal with misconduct using cautions (yellow cards) and send-offs (red cards).

Make Accurate Decisions:
Judge fouls, offsides (where applicable), restarts, goals, and infringements in real time.

Work with the Officiating Team:
Communicate effectively with assistant referees, fourth officials, and VAR (if used).

Manage Player and Team Conduct:
Handle dissent, manage technical areas, and communicate decisions clearly to players and coaches.

Apply Match Procedures:
Conduct pre-match checks (pitch, equipment, players), manage substitutions, keep time, and restart play correctly.

Report and Administration:
Complete match reports, including disciplinary actions, injuries, and incidents, accurately and on time.

Professional Standards:
Maintain fitness, knowledge of law changes, neutrality, and a high standard of behaviour on and off the pitch.

About the role:
We are seeking a motivated and enthusiastic individual to join our team as a Customer Service Executive. The ideal candidate will possess excellent communication skills, a friendly and professional demeanour, and a passion for providing exceptional customer service. As a member of the Customer Services Team, you will be responsible for addressing customer inquiries, resolving issues, and ensuring customer satisfaction. This role requires strong multitasking abilities and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
Developing and using their customer services expertise to identify and resolve customer queries in a timely manner.
Handling inbound and outbound calls to our customers, responding to a diverse range of problems and requests.
Achieving individual, and contributing to department, SLAs and KPIs ensuring value added service to our customers.
Identifying risks and opportunities for improvement, delivering simple, effective ways to improve the service we offer to our customers.
Escalating issues where appropriate to the Customer Services Manager.
Ensuring that all customers experience an exceptional level of service.
Key skills/attributes:
Excellent communication skills on all levels.
Ability to work on own initiative as well as part of a team.
Sound numerical skills.
Sense of urgency and the ability to work in a fast-paced office environment.
Deadline focused with ability to prioritise tasks.
Flexible and multi-tasking ability to produce results.
Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office, especially Microsoft Excel.

Please visit www.plan.com/careers for full details on the role and how to apply.

Notes
Graylaw International Freight Group is looking for an experienced and motivated Class 1 Lead Driver to take a hands-on leadership role within our Transport & Distribution operation.

This is not simply a driving position. We are looking for someone who understands freight and retail distribution, enjoys supporting other drivers and can bring practical operational experience to the team.

The successful candidate will remain an active driver and should be prepared to work flexibly across the operation. While holding a Class 1 licence is essential, there should be no issue working across all vehicle classes, including Class 2 and van work, where this is what the operation or customer requires.

The Lead Driver will help set the standard for the driving team, providing practical guidance, supporting effective route planning, promoting good defect-management practices and ensuring that vehicles are used safely, efficiently and appropriately.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who can motivate others and positively advocate Graylaw's PROUD values – Passion, Respect, Opportunity, Unity and Dependability.

Please contact the email address for further information Jamiekelly@graylaw.co.uk

Notes
£12.86 per hour | Up to 10 hours per week 

Southern Befrienders is looking for a friendly and reliable Minibus Driver to join our team on a part-time basis. This is initially a one-year, zero-hours contract, with regular hours expected on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and the potential for extension subject to funding. 

You will be responsible for safely transporting our service users to and from social events across the South of the Island, as well as managing the minibus diary and collection schedules. 

About You: 

Friendly, approachable, and empathetic towards older people 

Full, clean driving licence with D1 entitlement 

Good knowledge of southern communities is desirable 

Willing to undertake an enhanced DBS check 

For more information or a full job description, contact 833025 or email contact@southernbefrienders.im. 

To apply: Please send your CV and covering letter to contact@southernbefrienders.im. 

Closing date: Monday 24 August 2026. 

Learn more about Southern Befrienders at www.southernbefrienders.im or find us on Facebook.

Level 3 Practitioner – Dragonflies Nursery, Ramsey
We're looking for an enthusiastic Level 3 Early Years practitioner to join our team at Dragonflies Nursery in the heart of Ramsey. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a growing, purpose-built setting dedicated to creating a nurturing and enriching environment for children.
The ideal candidate will hold a Level 3 qualification in Early Years Education, have a genuine passion for working with young children, and bring a reliable, positive attitude to everything they do.
In return, we offer a competitive salary commensurate with experience, real opportunities for professional growth, and a supportive team who care deeply about the children in their care. You'll be joining a setting that's going from strength to strength, where your contribution genuinely matters.
To apply, send your CV and a short cover letter explaining why you'd be a great fit. If you haven't heard back within two weeks, please assume your application was unsuccessful. All offers are subject to DBS and relevant security checks.
We can't wait to hear from you.

For more information and to apply please contact shondelle@grasshoppers.im

FOREST SCHOOL LEADER / OUTDOOR ENTHUSIAST WANTED!
Are you happiest in muddy boots, building shelters and inspiring children to explore the great outdoors?
We’re looking for an energetic and capable Forest School Leader or experienced outdoor and bushcraft enthusiast to join Team Bees, working with children from 2 through to 11 years old.
This is a hands on role involving long days, energetic children and adventures in all weathers. You’ll need bags of enthusiasm, plenty of initiative and the stamina to get properly stuck in, if a little rain stops play, this probably isn’t the role for you! ?????
Essential requirements:
A relevant childcare qualification
 A full driving licence
A strong understanding of safeguarding
 The ability to complete thorough risk assessments independently
 Confidence working with children from babies to 11 years old
The energy and resilience to work outdoors for long periods in all weather and to make it immense fun for the little ones.
 Reliability, initiative and the ability to work as part of a team
A Forest School qualification or bushcraft experience would be highly desirable.
We need someone safety conscious and genuinely passionate about giving children exciting, meaningful and memorable experiences in nature.
Competitive rates of pay
Think you have the skills, energy and enthusiasm to join our hive? Send your CV and a little about yourself to:
 beehive1985@outlook.com

Notes
Due to continued growth and the successful award of several new contracts, we are seeking experienced and motivated Electrical Engineers to join our expanding team. The successful candidates will undertake a varied role covering both planned maintenance and project installation works across a range of commercial and multi-site environments. Duties will include carrying out Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) in line with scheduled programmes, responding promptly and effectively to reactive maintenance issues, and delivering electrical installations on both small and large-scale projects. The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times. Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position. Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities. Why Join Prospero Group? We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave. Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us. To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

The role will also involve issuing the appropriate electrical certification, including minor works and full installation certificates, diagnosing and resolving electrical faults, and maintaining consistently high standards of safety, workmanship, and customer service at all times. Applicants should hold the 18th Edition Wiring Regulations qualification together with NVQ Level 3 in Electro-technical Installation, City & Guilds Parts 2 and 3, or equivalent industry experience. Candidates must be able to demonstrate strong fault-finding and electrical installation skills, excellent communication and customer-facing abilities, and a proactive, self-motivated approach to work. A full driving licence is essential for this position. Experience working within commercial or multi-site environments would be advantageous, along with knowledge of periodic testing and inspection and familiarity with business-critical systems. This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing organisation with a strong pipeline of secured work, offering long-term stability and ongoing career development opportunities. Why Join Prospero Group? We offer a competitive salary based on experience, with guaranteed 40-hour weeks with overtime opportunities available. 25 days annual leave, UK and IOM bank holidays and annual birthday leave. Employees benefit from a company pension scheme, Bupa healthcare, and the provision of a company vehicle and uniform. We are committed to supporting our team through ongoing training and professional development opportunities, helping you build a long-term and rewarding career with us. To apply, please send your CV to hr@prospero.im. For a confidential discussion about the role, contact us on 01624 695250 or visit https://www.prospero.im/careers/

Swagelok Ltd

Tool Maker (Twilight Shift)

We are Hiring!

We are looking for an experienced Tool Maker on our twilight shift

Twilight shift (11 am – 21.00 pm working Monday to Thursday)

Toolmaker (Manual Machining & Tool Regrinding)

We are seeking a skilled and self-motivated Toolmaker with a strong background in manual machining and tool reconditioning. This role is focused on precision work using manual lathes and milling machines, alongside surface grinding, tool regrinding, and heat treatment processes.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship and the ability to interpret engineering drawings accurately, while engaging proactively with internal customers to deliver practical, high-quality solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Manufacture, modify, and repair tooling using manual lathes, milling machines, and grinders.
Independently, re-grind a wide range of cutting tools, including drills, reamers, and similar end-working tools, ensuring accuracy and timely turnaround.
Perform heat treatment processes as required to support tooling performance and longevity.
Carry out maintenance repairs to jigs, make new fixtures, gauges, and other tooling.
Set up and operate all relevant machine tools and equipment safely and efficiently.
Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify and resolve non-routine tooling or machining issues.
Work collaboratively with customers and colleagues to develop practical and cost-effective solutions.
Skills & Experience

Strong hands-on experience in traditional toolmaking, with a focus on manual machining processes.
Proven ability to re-grind and restore a variety of cutting tools independently.
Competence in surface grinding and heat treatment techniques.
Excellent understanding of engineering drawings, tolerances, and materials.
Ability to work with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication skills and a customer-focused mindset.
Additional Requirements

Adheres to all plant regulatory and safety requirements.
Supports the company operating plan and aligns with Swagelok’s mission, vision, and values.
About You

This opportunity is ideal for a dedicated professional who takes pride in their work, thrives in a team environment, and consistently delivers high standards in customer service, quality, and cost-effectiveness.

To apply please visit our recruitment portal at http://iomjobs.swagelok.com

Swagelok Ltd.
Maintenance Housekeeper.
Swagelok is a global engineering company, manufacturing a wide range of high-quality components to a world market, which offers a competitive benefits package for all employees.
Due to continued growth in our Isle of Man site, we are looking for a maintenance housekeeper to join our facilities and maintenance department.
The successful candidates will be responsible for following the company’s general housekeeping and safety practices & policies. They will also be required to independently identify and perform general cleaning for their areas of responsibility.
Additional tasks include supporting our maintenance technicians with general upkeep of our facility including CNC machining centres, assisting with machine moves and installation of new equipment.
As a customer facing site, we require the successful candidate to show close attention to detail, to take pride in their work and ensure a high standard is maintained in all aspects of their roll.
It is preferred that the applicant; holds a counterbalance forklift licence, has experience with food & hygiene in the workplace and is manual handling trained.
The roll can be physical demanding and an applicant must be capable of being on their feet for up to 8- hours a day. Lift, push, pull or carry weight no more than 35lbs, as well as squat bend and reach.
This exciting opportunity would suit an individual who thrives in a team environment, whilst achieving high standards of customer service, quality, and cost effectiveness.
If you are interested in applying for this role, please visit our online portal at http://iomjobs.Swagelok.com

To drive and scale strategic enablement from Offshore centres into Africa, aligning offshore capabilities with the needs of African commercial clients. This role ensures the seamless integration of the Africa-Offshore value proposition, enabling agile teams, enhancing client experience, and promoting sustainable growth through collaboration with offshore-based stakeholders
Lead the execution of Africa-focused strategic initiatives from Offshore centres, ensuring offshore capabilities are aligned to the commercial priorities, growth ambitions, and client needs of African markets.
Develop and champion the Africa-Offshore strategic enablement framework, creating a consistent operating model, governance structure, and communication approach that embeds offshore capabilities across African client value chains.
Provide strategic advisory to Offshore and African stakeholders on market opportunities, regulatory considerations, and operating models that optimise client outcomes while maintaining compliance across offshore jurisdictions.

Influence strategic investment and prioritisation decisions by evaluating opportunities across African markets and recommending initiatives that maximise client impact, revenue growth and long-term sustainability.
Monitor and evaluate the performance of Africa-originated offshore business, using data and commercial insights to identify trends, measure strategic outcomes, and recommend continuous improvements to enhance business performance.
Act as the central strategic liaison between Africa and Offshore centres, ensuring alignment of priorities, effective stakeholder engagement, and successful execution of cross-border initiatives.
Promote a culture of innovation and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, enhance the client experience, and strengthen Offshore value proposition to African commercial clients.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English being essential.
Proficiency in Microsoft Word for document creation and management, along with a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for spreadsheet and data-related tasks.

Experience of coaching, mentoring, or training colleagues would be advantageous, particularly in supporting the development of junior team members.

Previous experience within a financial services or Credit environment.

Notes
Our client seeks a Client Bookkeeper to join their team on a 12 Month contract. This role offers an excellent opportunity to work within a sophisticated, director-led environment, supporting the financial administration of discerning private clients. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining comprehensive financial records, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and facilitating the production of high-quality financial reporting. Key Responsibilities: Ensuring all entities have accounting ledgers set up on Viewpoint or relevant accounting systems .Maintaining consistency with central chart of accounts and obtaining approval for any changes. Processing purchase and sales invoices for client accounting purposes.Posting bank entries through manual entry or upload processes. Reconciling customer receipts, supplier payments and bank statements. Processing monthly journals and accruals as required.Reviewing ledger accounts to ensure readiness for year-end statement preparation.Preparing year-end journals and accounts files for Financial Statement preparation.Engaging with client administrators regarding accounting queries. Preparing VAT returns and ensuring timely submission. Preparing client bank reconciliations for review.Producing management accounts and aged debtor/creditor lists. Completing time billing system entries on a daily basis.Preparing minutes to approve tax returns and Financial Statements. Drafting simple financial statements where required. Key Skills and Experience: Relevant qualification (CAT/AAT) or demonstrable willingness to study. Minimum 3 years; relevant experience in CSP or related environment.Knowledge and experience of accounting software systems, particularly Viewpoint and Xero.Proven experience processing invoices, reconciling accounts and maintaining accounting ledger systems. Understanding of relevant legislation and regulation of financial accounts administration. Strong IT skills including Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.Excellent numerical, analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16510

Our client seeks a Part Time Qualified Accountant to join their team (20 - 25 hours per week - Flexible) Role Profile: Forming part of an experienced team at a small Office, the successful applicant will take responsibility for the accounting function on a day to day basis, covering a number of companies and trusts and various reporting processes. Given the nature of the business, being a small team, the role will also at times involve providing holiday cover for other team members and therefore there is a requirement for the applicant to be flexible in their approach to job responsibilities. Experience and competence in the preparation and review of management accounts and financial statements (FRS 102A) is crucial. Key Responsibilities: Take responsibility for the accounting function and provide suitable oversight of a bookkeeper. Processing of payments and liaising with banks accordingly. Bank reconciliations. Investment reconciliations and liaising with banks/asset managers accordingly. Processing of day to day transactional accounting entries. Processing of month/quarter end accounting journals. Key Skills and Experience: A qualified accountant (ACCA/ACA), preferably 'big four' trained desirable. Have a minimum of 2 years PQE. Have management accounting experience including day to day transactional responsibility for operational companies and the preparation of management accounts and financial statements for such companies (prepared under UK GAAP, typically FRS 102A). Have substantial experience in the review of various reporting, including bespoke financial reporting, management accounts and financial statement prepared by junior members of the team. Knowledge of the Paxus fund accounting system (primary accounting system used) and Sage accounts would be an advantage, but not essential as training will be provided. Strong MS Excel capability is highly preferable. Experience working with MS PowerBI (or a similar reporting tool) is preferable but not essential. Excellent Benefits package: Competitive salary. Life cover/death in service. Private healthcare cover. Paid CPD and relevant Professional Subscriptions. If relevant, study support for professional qualifications. 25 days holiday (pro rata),...

For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16681

Our client seeks a FP & A manager to join their team. A deep understanding of financial management principles and a proven track record of driving process improvements are part of the core of this role. Key Responsibilities: Conduct the annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning processes. Develop and maintain complex financial models to support decision-making across the organisation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and subsidiaries to ensure alignment of financial plans with strategic objectives. Challenge assumptions in budgets, forecasts, and business cases to ensure financial plans are robust and realistic. Prepare presentations and analysis for senior leadership and PLC Board reporting. Analyse financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for growth. Drive improvements in financial processes, systems, and reporting capabilities to enhance efficiency and accuracy. Key Skills and Experience: Professionally qualified (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent). Experience in FP&A, with demonstrated ownership of budgeting and forecasting processes. Experience in a listed business or multi-entity group would be a significant advantage. Expert financial modelling and analytical skills. High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial software applications, such as SAP. In-depth knowledge of accounting principles, financial statement analysis, and management reporting. Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a results-driven mindset

About the Role: 
We’re growing our team to better support our global market clients, extending our service beyond core business hours to meet their everyday banking needs.  
Join us as a Customer Service Advisor and be part of this next phase of growth.  
In this role, you’ll deliver a great experience for our clients as their first point of contact.  You’ll support them with their everyday banking needs, building strong relationships, developing your skills and growing your knowledge in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

https://barclays.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/External_Career_Site_Barclays/job/Glasgow-Campus/Customer-Service-Advisor--24-7-shift-pattern_JR-0000117716

Shift Pattern: 

Rotation across day, evening and overnight shift, including a mix of weekdays and weekend working. 
Typical shift times range between 20:00 – 06:30 and 22:15 – 09:00, with some afternoon and evening shifts (14:00 – 23:45). 
Built on an 8-week rotational cycle to provide variety and fairness across shifts.

What You’ll Be Doing 

Delivering client service across telephony and written channels. 
Building, trusted relationships by understanding needs and responding with empathy and professionalism. 
Supporting clients with their banking products and services, offering solutions that meet their circumstances. 
Listening carefully to understand and provide clear, accurate, and timely support.

The role: 
The Senior Digital Marketing Executive will provide support for the Markets and Marketing function as well as the wider CDs firm. The ideal candidate should be diligent and well-versed running social media campaign and assisting in maintaining and updating the Crown Dependencies website. The candidate should also be familiar with design software, such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign. The person should have the ability to plan, execute and manage timelines excellently. The role will require communication to stakeholders at all levels.

Accountabilities:
Support the team with campaign production and execution where needed, from global thought leadership to local events.
Create emails to be distributed internally and externally.
General administration which might include helping event suppliers with invoices, managing the job tracker, managing data into our CRM system, manage email queries regarding events.
Assist with eMarketing, including use of our CRM system and sending emails externally.
Maintain and update the local Crown Dependencies website. This includes liaising with other departments to ensure that the information included is accurate to the services they provide.
Act as creative lead for the marketing team – includes overseeing design work done by other members of the team and ensure brand guideline compliance.
Creating and scheduling social media content for LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram posts that are in line with our brand guidelines and in terms of imagery and tone of voice.
Develop and manage social media campaigns, both organic and paid.
Efficiently analyse the performance of both social media and the website to inform decision-making of future digital marketing activities.
Provide training to other departments within the firm to ensure brand compliance of documents that are sent to clients / external stakeholders.
Other marketing tasks may be included as the candidate becomes familiar with the working environment and team.

Candidate requirements:
Ideally hold CIM professional qualification or equivalent, or have studied some sort of marketing, and/ or 4-5yrs experience working in a marketing role.
Strong networking and presentation skills.
Excellent experience running digital marketing campaigns.
Previous experience with Adobe software is advantageous.
An ability to express views and ideas articulately, from both a written and oral perspective.
Confident and independent personal skills.
Ability to multi-task, prioritise workloads and meet agreed timeframes.

Notes
Our client is seeking an experienced and qualified finance leader to take full ownership of their global Accounting & Control function. Reporting directly to the CFO, this is a senior, high-impact role within a dynamic multinational trading group with offices across Europe, Africa, and Latin America. The successful candidate will have already operated at a senior level within a complex multinational environment and will bring a demonstrable track record of leading accounting functions, managing audit relationships, and driving compliance standards across multiple entities. The role carries one direct report and functional oversight responsibility for all regional accounting, control, and compliance teams across the Group. Key Skills and Experience: ACA (Institute of Chartered Accountants in England & Wales), CA (SA) (South African Institute of Chartered Accountants), or CPA (US Certified Public Accountant) - these are the benchmark qualifications for this role and represent a near non-negotiable requirement. Candidates holding ACCA or CIMA will be considered only where there is an exceptional and demonstrable track record of technical depth, complexity, and seniority that fully compensates for the qualification differential.Minimum 8 to 12 years of progressive post-qualification experience in financial control, accounting, or audit.Demonstrated experience in a senior leadership role with full functional ownership of an accounting or control function within a multinational environment.Proven expertise in US GAAP reporting, including consolidated financial statement preparation and oversight. **Our client is happy to consider relocation and covering visa costs if you have the trading and commodities along with US GAAP and SOX experience. CPA qualification preferred but CA/ACA would be considered if you have the above.**
 For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16712

Apply Via: https://smrtr.io/BhZvD
To independently implement and manage a range of complex Structured Corporate Loan transactions as intended by the loan agreement, in support of the IB business and Wholesale Clients clients'.
Actively monitor, identify, investigate, resolve and / or escalate complex issues relating to the deal throughout the life of each live transaction and regularly communicate with stakeholders in order to maintain appropriate positions and efficient operations, ensure the transaction terms and conditions are adhered to by the client and / or third parties, provide a high-quality service, and mitigate operational risk.
Collect and lodge all transaction collateral documentation (e.g. legal agreements, security agreements, share certificates) with the Collateral team for safe keeping and feed downstream calculations for capital management and credit risk mitigation. Coordinate with Legal, Credit and Collateral to approve and authorise various collateral (security) releases.
Consult stakeholders, provide relevant operational expertise regarding complex Structured Loan transaction operational requirements into cross-functional enablement teams, provide approvals and participate in post product deployment reviews, to ensure the effective operation of new product development and smooth activations.
Coordinate and inform stakeholders of the transaction close out when it reaches maturity, to ensure stakeholders are aligned, Wholesale Clients records are reliable and valid, and the capital management process is well supported. Where applicable, provide instructions to release all required collateral.
Create complex transactions on ACBS based on the salient features from the legal agreement to create an accounting record, enable the ongoing administration, monitoring and management of the facility and to facilitate ongoing reporting requirements.

Notes
Our client seeks a reliable and detail-focuse Bookkeeper to join their team. The successful candidate will be responsible for recording transactions, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and payments, and preparing basic financial information for the management and accountant. Key Responsibilities: Record day-to-day financial transactions accurately, including sales, purchases, receipts and payments. Process supplier invoices, customer invoices, expenses and payment runs. Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including chasing outstanding payments where required. Reconcile bank accounts and petty cash regularly. Maintain accurate ledgers and ensure records are complete, organised and up to date. Payroll processing, pension submissions and related records when required. Assist with VAT returns, tax records and other statutory reporting requirements. Prepare basic financial reports such as aged debt, cash flow summaries, profit and loss information and balance sheet reconciliations. Liaise with suppliers, customers and colleagues to resolve queries. Maintain confidentiality and ensure financial records comply with company policies and relevant regulations. Key Skills and Experience: A relevant bookkeeping or accounting qualification would be beneficial but is not essential if the candidate has strong practical experience. Candidates who are qualified by experience will also be considered. Previous experience in bookkeeping, accounts administration or a similar finance role. Good understanding of bookkeeping principles, reconciliations and financial record keeping. Confident using accounting software. Good Microsoft Excel and general IT skills. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16742

Notes
Our client seeks a Head of Management Accounting to join their team. Role Profile: To ensure the monthly management accounts for the Group are produced on a timely basis and are complete and accurate. Key Responsibilities: Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Group Finance department (Isle of Man and UK). Manage and review the management accounts process for all subsidiaries of the group, ensuring production and distribution within 10 working days. Preparation of monthly Group Management accounts and distributing to the Boards within 10 working days, assisting with any questions and queries. Co-ordinate and review the credit risk report and provide commentary. Attend and contribute in Credit Committee meetings, adequately answering all questions from members. Monthly review of payroll (Isle of Man and UK), control account reconciliation and defined benefit payment and reconciliation. Co-ordinating and reviewing efficiencies and assisting with projects when required. Liaison for internal and external audit in respect of Management Accounting enquiries. Liaison for internal departments for finance related matters in respect to daily operations. Ensuring timely completion and submission of Corporate Tax returns (Isle of Man and UK). Reviewing work completed by other team members, raising any issues arising at an early stage. Ensure timely release of electronic payments whilst ensuring payment release controls are maintained. Supervisor of Sun/Vision Systems for the Management Accounting group. Assist with the training of staff members, working with them to expand their knowledge and experience. Key Skills & Experience A minimum of 5 years' experience in the finance sector. ACCA or ACA qualified. Supervisor/ System Administrator SUN/VISION account systems. Report writing. Systematic work approach and excellent attention to detail. ICEB Administrator or similar experience. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16738

The Finance Administrator role encompasses the reconciliation of all transactions on bank accounts and control accounts, emphasising a high degree of accuracy, confidentiality, and organisation. This position requires managing sensitive financial transactions while supporting the wider finance team in maintaining robust financial controls. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with internal departments to ensure the timely clearance of all bank statement and control account entries. Daily and monthly reconciliations of multi-currency bank and control accounts are integral to this role, ensuring all transactions are matched to internal system records and completed to the company’s standards within strict deadlines. Furthermore, this role will involve investigating and resolving outstanding reconciliation items and escalating complex issues as necessary. A focus on upholding and enhancing financial procedures will be vital for the candidate, making this an exciting opportunity for someone looking to develop their finance career in a supportive environment. This is a full-time, permanent position, with standard hours set at 35 hours per week. Please email team@itchyfeet.im or follow the link for further information and for details on how to apply https://itchyfeetoffshore.com/jobs/37916-finance-administrator-isle-of-man/

Our client seeks a Part-Time - Part Qualified Accountant to join their team. (Between 25 to 30 hours per week - Flexible). Forming part of an experienced team at a small Office, the successful applicant will take day to day responsibility for a number of companies and trusts and various reporting processes, in addition to the compilation of management accounts on a quarterly basis. Preparation of annual financial statements may also be required, however guidance in this area will be provided where necessary. Key Skills and Experience: Be an experienced bookkeeper, preferably AAT/CAT qualified (or part qualified ACCA/ACA). Have experience of day to day journal entries, bank reconciliations, payments, accruals, prepayments, supplier control accounts. Have experience in the preparation of management accounts and financial statements for Isle of Man CompaniesKnowledge of the Paxus fund accounting system (primary accounting system used) and Sage accounts would be an advantage, but not essential as training will be provided. This role would be suited to either an experienced bookkeeper seeking a new challenge or a part qualified accountant. The successful candidate will be joining a small team supported by the Directors. Excellent Benefits Package: Competitive salary. Life cover/death in service. Private healthcare cover Paid CPD and Professional Subscriptions. If relevant, study support for professional qualifications. 25 days holiday (pro rata), increasing to 28 days (pro rata) after 5 years service. All Manx bank holidays.  For a full list of responsibilities and requirements or to apply for this great role, please visit the website at searchandselect.com, quoting the reference number: 16682

Collaborate with colleagues on multidisciplinary projects. Continue developing your technical knowledge while supporting the growth of the wider practice. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset. Excellent communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with clients and colleagues. Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. A collaborative approach and a genuine desire to continue learning and developing. Able to take accountability and responsibility for own personal development. Able to work independently within agreed objectives, taking personal responsibility for delivery.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit job.autisminitiatives.org.

Join a brilliant team on the Isle of Man, committed to supporting autistic people to live as independently as possible and to be part of their local community. Autism Initiatives work positively alongside people with autism, providing specialist services that are tailored to each individual.

We are seeking friendly Support Workers to join us at our Residential services. We have a number of houses located in Central and Northern parts of the Island within easy reach of local bus routes.

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic and will enjoy joining a team that encourages people with autism to enjoy an active lifestyle. Community activities could include swimming, accessing walking groups or trips to the cinema or even camping trips and gorge walking. Support Workers promote health and well-being and support individuals to maintain their home. The support we deliver is flexible and unique to each individual, building on their strengths and driven by their goals.

Experience is not essential, but a genuine desire to making a difference to the lives of people with autism, as well as a positive attitude is. This is truly a rewarding role, with the opportunity for you to develop your skills, knowledge and fulfil your career aspirations.

We particularly welcome applications from candidates who hold a manual driving licence.

For more information, or to apply, please visit jobs.autisminitiatives.org.

If you are passionate about dentistry and eager to contribute to a thriving practice, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity as an Associate Dentist.

Notes
Support Worker:
Thank you for your interest in the post of support worker here at Viva Heights. 
Viva Heights is an Adult Mental Health & Complex Needs service. We are based in Douglas and work with people with complex needs, supporting them in their own recovery.
Supporting people in various areas of identified need, including; Mental Health, wellbeing and emotions, Physical health, medication needs, hygiene routine, communication, daily living skills, quality of life and activities, relationships, education and employment, finances and budgets, dependency needs, community safety, legal matters and housing support. Staff must be motivated, sensible, flexible in their ways of working and have empathy for others. 
We work with people with long term needs, short term placements, specific interventions, emergency placements and respite care.
We can offer, contracted 37.5 hours per week, excellent rates of pay, 25 days annual leave plus any bank holidays worked. 8 week rolling rota (issued 2 months in advance). Excellent training opportunities. A great work environment with a fantastic team.
If successful, the candidate will need to have a DBS check completed by Viva Heights and two satisfactory references prior to starting work. A full induction will be given and a period of shadowing will be offered as part of a 6 month probation period. 
The day support worker shifts are typically: 
Late sleep early = 12:00 - 22:00 - sleep at service then 08:00 - 14:00
Early day = 08:00 - 16:00
Late day = 12:00 - 20:00
Day shift = 10:00 – 18:00

The hourly rate for support workers is £12.90 per hour and sleep in shifts are paid additionally at £50 per night. 
Breaks are usually allocated at the start of shift and taken around the needs of residents.

This position is open for settled IOM workers only. As a small residential care home, we do not have the ability to employ people who require sponsorship or visa applications at this time.

To apply for this role please email managervivaheights@vivavest.uk or call 624147

Notes
Quay Dental is seeking a newly qualified GDC-registered Dental Therapist to join our team from September 2026. We are a modern private dental clinic located in the heart of Douglas on the beautiful Isle of Man, committed to delivering exceptional patient care within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated Clinician looking to further develop their skills, with mentorship from an experienced Principal Dentist who will provide ongoing guidance, training and support. The role is initially offered as a 12-month training position with the opportunity for a permanent role thereafter. As a Dental Therapist at Quay Dental, you will undertake the full scope of dental therapy within your competence, including intra-oral scanning, while providing hygiene and therapy treatments using the latest technology including air-polishing. Our vision is to provide a therapy-led approach to dental maintenance, with the Dental Therapist playing an integral role within the team. You will work closely alongside our Dentists and existing Therapist to provide maintenance and treatment appointments with full dental nurse support. There will also be the opportunity to undertake a Postgraduate Diploma programme to further enhance your clinical skills and knowledge. We offer a salary of £40,000 based on a four-day week, together with a bonus scheme, reimbursed GDC fees, up to six weeks holiday pro-rata including bank holidays, private healthcare insurance and postgraduate training support. Outside of work, you will enjoy the very best of coastal living on the scenic Isle of Man, with beaches, countryside, wildlife and excellent quality of life, alongside low crime, excellent schools and fantastic transport links to the UK. With a maximum upper tax bracket of just 21%, your earnings can go significantly further. To apply or arrange a confidential conversation, please contact careers@quaydental.co.uk

A full induction programme will be provided, together with ongoing training and opportunities for continued professional development. Applicants must have previous experience in domiciliary care, preferably in a senior or supervisory role, be a car driver with access to a reliable vehicle, and possess excellent communication and leadership skills. Notes
Karsons Pharmacy is seeking an experienced Pharmacy Technician or Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT) to join our growing independent community pharmacy team. This is an excellent opportunity to work within a progressive organisation committed to delivering outstanding patient care while supporting the continued development of pharmacy services across our branches.

You will play a key role in ensuring the safe, accurate and efficient delivery of dispensing services, working closely with pharmacists and the wider pharmacy team. The role includes supporting daily dispensary operations, maintaining high professional standards, contributing to service improvements, and helping to develop efficient workflows that enhance the patient experience. There will also be opportunities to become involved in new pharmacy services and operational projects as the business continues to grow.

Applicants must have a minimum of five years' experience working in community pharmacy and be a qualified Pharmacy Technician or Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT) registered with the GPhC. You should have an excellent understanding of community pharmacy practice, strong organisational and communication skills, and the ability to work confidently both independently and as part of a team. We are looking for someone who is proactive, reliable, commercially aware, embraces technology, and is committed to delivering high-quality patient care while supporting colleagues and contributing to continuous improvement.

In return, we offer a competitive salary that is negotiable depending on experience, performance bonus opportunities following successful completion of probation, ongoing professional development, training in additional pharmacy services where appropriate, opportunities to broaden your clinical and technical skills, and the chance to build a long-term career within an ambitious independent pharmacy. You will work alongside an experienced leadership team that values collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.

If you would like to join a forward-thinking community pharmacy where your contribution is recognised and your professional development is encouraged, we would be delighted to hear from you. Please submit your CV together with a short covering note explaining why you would like to join our team to jobs@karsonspharmacy.co.uk.

Application Question: Which personal value has had the greatest impact on your work, and how has it helped you deliver excellent patient care while contributing to the success of the pharmacy?

Notes
About Us:

Woodbourne Dental is a modern and well-established dental practice in Douglas, Isle of Man, committed to providing top-quality dental care in a friendly and professional environment. We are seeking a dedicated and organized Dental Nurse to join our team.

Job Purpose

To provide chairside support to dental professionals while delivering excellent patient care and progressing towards a recognized dental nursing qualification.

Key Responsibilities

Assist the dentist during a variety of treatments, including routine check-ups, fillings, and surgical procedures.
Set up and clean down surgeries before and after each patient in accordance with infection prevention and control protocols.
Ensure all equipment is sterilized and safe for use, following infection control procedures.
Prepare and maintain the clinical environment, including instruments and materials.
Perform intraoral scanning under supervision, aiding with digital impressions and workflow for orthodontic, restorative, or cosmetic treatments.
Deliver excellent patient care and support, ensuring a comfortable and welcoming experience.
Accurately record patient details, procedures, and notes as directed by the dentist, including maintaining logbooks.
Ensure that patient confidentiality is always maintained.
Adhere to all CQC, GDPR, and health and safety guidelines.
Attend off-site or online training as part of the dental nurse qualification.
Participate in the wider team effort, including reception duties or assisting other nurses and clinicians as needed.
Stay updated with current dental best practices and maintain CPD in line with GDC requirements (qualified nurses) or training program guidelines (trainees).
Essential Requirements:

A genuine interest in dental healthcare and patient welfare.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to enrol in and complete an accredited dental nursing qualification.
Professional appearance and attitude.
Ability to follow instructions and work under pressure.
Must be a resident on IOM or have a valid working permit
Desirable but not essential:

Previous experience in a healthcare or customer service role.
Knowledge of basic dental terminology.
Familiarity with dental software (e.g. SOE, R4) is a plus.

Premium Care Isle of Man are looking for caring and dedicated Community Support Workers to join our friendly team, supporting adults with mental health needs and learning disabilities to live independently in their own homes. We are seeking compassionate, respectful and reliable individuals with good communication skills. Experience and qualifications are preferred but not essential, as full training will be provided. Applicants must hold a full driving licence and have access to their own vehicle. An enhanced DBS check is required. We offer competitive pay rates, rolled-up holiday pay, mileage allowance, ongoing training, and 24/7 management support. Come and join our supportive and friendly team. We are looking to recruit experienced health care assistants to join our team at Silverdale Care Home. 
As a Health Care Assistant your role is to provide dignified and individualised support to older people who may require extra assistance. You will work as part of an established team providing support to our residents with day to day care. You will need to be a kind, caring individual who likes to provide care and support helping others. Principal Duties Include: To assist in providing highest standards of personal care and attention for the residents. To assist with personal hygiene as per care plan. Providing support at mealtimes, helping to serve meals, prepare tables. Promote independence and wellbeing of our residents. To be polite and helpful at all times i.e. appropriate conduct and attitude towards the residents, visitors and colleagues at all times.
We are offering day and night shifts (you will need to advise if you have a preference). This role is physically demanding but also provides the opportunity to learn and grow and ensure that our residents are provided with a high standard of person-centred care. A full induction programme will be provided upon commencement of employment. 
We provide an ongoing training programme throughout each year to promote professional development.
We will require an enhanced DBS check.  Uniform is provided. If you are interested in applying for this position, please contact Michelle on email office@silverdalecare.com to request the application form.

Notes
We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic and approachable Catering Manager to join our team at The Milntown Estate and take responsibility for the day-to-day running and development of our front-of-house catering operation.
Our café is an important part of Milntown and is often the first point of contact for people visiting the Estate. We want someone who can lead and support our existing team, maintain the friendly and welcoming atmosphere, and help us continue to improve and grow the business.
The role will involve managing and supporting the front-of-house team, preparing rotas and ensuring appropriate staffing levels, maintaining excellent customer service, overseeing stock and ordering, managing costs and budgets, and looking for opportunities to increase sales and develop what we offer.
Milntown is also a busy events venue, so you will work alongside our Events & Marketing Manager and Head Chef to help plan and deliver the catering side of weddings, functions, wakes and other events held across the Estate.
Maintaining high standards will be an important part of the role. This includes food hygiene, health and safety, cleaning schedules and other relevant procedures and regulations, working together with the Head Chef where responsibilities are shared across the operation.
This is very much a hands-on role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being part of the team and is happy to get involved when needed, particularly during busy services, functions and events.
For a full recruitment pack and detailed job description, or if you would like to find out more about the role, please contact General Manager Adam Quayle at estateoffice@milntown.org.

Notes
Join a seafood?led kitchen on the Isle of Man’s west coast

The Boatyard is a busy, modern coastal restaurant on Peel harbour, known for fresh seafood, seasonal menus, and a warm, professional team culture. We’re looking for a talented Sous Chef to join our kitchen and help lead service with creativity, consistency, and pride.

The Role:
As Sous Chef, you’ll work closely with our Head Chef to deliver high?quality, seafood?focused dishes that celebrate local produce. You’ll take ownership of day?to?day kitchen operations, support junior chefs, and ensure every plate leaving the pass reflects our standards.

What We’re Looking For:
Strong experience in a professional kitchen, ideally with seafood, confidence running a section and leading service, a passion for fresh, local produce, good communication and leadership skills, high standards, attention to detail, and pride in your work, someone who thrives in a busy, supportive team environment. 

What We Offer:
Competitive pay based on experience, a supportive, friendly team and positive working culture, opportunities for progression and creative input, a beautiful coastal workplace with a strong local following.

If you’re a skilled chef who loves seafood, enjoys working with quality ingredients, and wants to be part of a respected harbour?side restaurant, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply with your CV and a short introduction why you would be ideal for this position, why include some photos of your food and tell us about your favourite dishes,  to fish@theboatyardpeel.com

We’re looking for chefs who takes pride in producing great food, enjoys working as part of a team and thrives in a busy kitchen environment. You’ll be working alongside our kitchen management team to help deliver the high-quality food that Smoky Sam’s is known for.

As a CDP or Sous Chef, you’ll be responsible for running your section to a high standard, preparing and cooking food consistently, maintaining excellent food hygiene and safety standards and helping to ensure every dish leaving the kitchen meets our expectations.

You’ll be expected to take responsibility for your section, including preparation, stock rotation, ordering and maintaining a clean and organised workstation. You’ll also help support junior members of the kitchen team, communicate effectively during service and work closely with the senior kitchen team to keep services running smoothly.

For the right person, this role can offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility and progress within the business. We’re looking for someone who wants to develop their skills, is confident working under pressure and is willing to lead by example.

Previous professional kitchen experience is essential, with CDP or Sous Chef experience preferred. Experience working in a busy restaurant environment would be a strong advantage. BBQ experience isn’t essential, but a genuine passion for food and willingness to learn our style of cooking is a must.
We’re looking for someone who is reliable, organised and passionate about hospitality. You’ll need to be a strong team player with a positive attitude and the ability to stay calm and focused during busy services.

If you’re looking for your next challenge and want to be part of a growing BBQ restaurant with a strong team and plenty of opportunity to develop, we’d love to hear from you.

Please Email smokysamsbbq@gmail.com with a copy of your CV

You’ll also help maintain our high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food safety throughout the kitchen.

We’re looking for someone who is hardworking, reliable and takes pride in keeping things clean and organised. You’ll need to be comfortable working in a busy kitchen environment and able to work well as part of a team. Hospitality or kitchen experience is preferred but isn’t essential, as the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important to us.

Smoky Sam’s can be a fast-paced environment, especially during busy services, so you’ll need to be able to work under pressure, keep a positive attitude and be willing to get stuck in wherever needed.

We’re proud of our team and believe that every role in the kitchen is important. If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, develop your skills and become part of a friendly and hardworking team, we’d love to hear from you.

Smoky Sam’s BBQ is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Restaurant Supervisor to join our team.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about great food, excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for both our customers and our team. As a Restaurant Supervisor, you’ll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the restaurant and helping to make sure every customer has a fantastic experience.

You’ll be responsible for supervising the team during shifts, ensuring the restaurant is running smoothly and maintaining our high standards of service, cleanliness and food quality. You’ll lead by example, support and motivate team members, and help create a friendly and welcoming environment.

The ideal person will have previous experience in a restaurant, hospitality or supervisory role, although we’re also happy to consider someone with the right attitude, personality and willingness to learn. You’ll need to be confident communicating with both customers and staff, able to stay calm and organised during busy periods, and comfortable taking responsibility when required.

You’ll help with opening and closing the restaurant, managing shifts, supporting the team during busy services, dealing with customer queries and resolving any issues professionally. You’ll also work closely with management to ensure company standards and procedures are followed.

We believe our team is just as important as the food we serve. We’re looking for someone who is reliable, approachable, hardworking and enjoys being part of a team. If you’re someone who takes pride in your work and wants to help us continue providing great food and great service, we’d love to hear from you.
 Please send a copy of your CV and a small bit about yourself and why you would be a great fit at Smoky Sam's to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:  
Enthusiastic, energetic and resourceful with excellent customer service. Hard worker, professionally committed and responsible. Maintain focus in demanding work environments, under deadline and pressure conditions. 
Making pizza dough, managing dough fermentation, production of dough balls. -Preparation of vegetables, meats, sausages, sauces. 
Inspect and clean food preparation areas, such as equipment and work surfaces, or serving areas to ensure safe and sanitary food handling practices. 
Ensure food is stored and cooked at correct temperature by regulating temperature of ovens, grills, and fryers. 
Ensure freshness of food and ingredients by checking for quality, keeping track of old and new items, rotating stock.  
Season and cook foods according to recipes or personal judgment and experience being sure to constantly turn or stir foods to ensure even cooking.  
Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients according to recipes or personal judgment.  
Take orders from customers and cook foods requiring short preparation time and according to customer’s requirements.  
Restock kitchen supplies, rotate food, and stamp the time and date on food in coolers. 
Applying correct toppings on the desired crust style, and then baking. 
Have to know the importance of teamwork. 
Cleanliness and food safety standards must always be the first concern through this process.  
Assembling pizzas exactly as the customer had ordered. 
Deep cleaning to the kitchen ones a week. 
Needs to have some knowledge about dough, flour, yeast, dough fermentation. 
Also needs to have some knowledge about toppings like cheese, some vegetables and some meats. Training can be given if is needed. 

Abilities required: 
 Must be able to work on evenings and late nights. 
Must be able to work long hours. 
Must be able to work on bank holidays and special days. 
Must be able to work in busy and hot kitchen. 
Must be able to work fast and accurate. 
Must be able to work under pressure and meet deadlines, while maintaining a positive attitude and providing exemplary customer service. 
Ability to work independently and to carry out assignments to completion.
Physical Requirements:  
Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions. 
Must be able to lift and carry up to 50 lbs.

For more details and to apply contact bfpizza.iom@gmail.com

We're Hiring!
Front of House Team Member
South of the Island

Are you a friendly, energetic people-person who loves great coffee, good food and even better company? Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH)
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends)
Pay: Minimum wage
Location: South of the island
Own transport: Essential

What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
Opening and closing of the cafe
Greet, assist and seat guests
Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH)
Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food)
Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards
Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals
Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service
Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service
Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed
Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers
Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation
Filing of delivery notes and invoices
Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items
Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies
Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required
Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback
Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling
Always maintain a professional appearance
Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners

About You
Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred
Own reliable transport is essential
Warm, friendly and customer-focused
Reliable, punctual and well-presented
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team
Good communication skills and a positive attitude
Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends
What We Offer
A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment
Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster
The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe.

How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im.

Our cafe in the south of the island is on the lookout for a warm, reliable Front of House team member to join our small, close-knit crew. If you take pride in looking after guests and keeping a busy cafe running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
The Role
Position: Front of House (FOH)
Hours: 30-40 hours per week (across weekdays and weekends)
Pay: Minimum wage
Location: South of the island
Own transport: Essential
What You'll Be Doing
As part of our Front of House team, your day-to-day will include:
•	Opening and closing of the cafe
•	Greet, assist and seat guests
•	Take customer orders efficiently and accurately and communicate orders to Back of House (BOH)
•	Provide a good level of customer service (including preparation of beverages and food)
•	Maintaining order within the cafe and adhere to required standards
•	Setting of tables and assisting BOH with delivery of meals
•	Co-ordination between FOH and BOH to maintain timely service
•	Clearing of tables during service and cleaning of tables and surrounds post service
•	Ensuring the outside deck, cafe, bar area and bathrooms are kept clean and maintained at appropriate hygiene standards and a professional image is always portrayed
•	Ordering of beverage and snack stock from suppliers
•	Inventory management – replenishment of beverages, snacks and condiments, including stock rotation
•	Filing of delivery notes and invoices
•	Monthly stocktaking of all FOH items
•	Accurate recording of transactions and end of day cash-up and safe keeping of monies
•	Replying to emails and telephonic bookings if required
•	Receiving and accumulating general customer feedback
•	Preparation of staff rosters and work scheduling
•	Always maintain a professional appearance
•	Performing any reasonable ad-hoc tasks requested by the Manager / Owners
About You
•	Previous hospitality or cafe experience preferred
•	Own reliable transport is essential
•	Warm, friendly and customer-focused
•	Reliable, punctual and well-presented
•	Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and as part of a team
•	Good communication skills and a positive attitude
•	Able to work flexible shifts, including weekends
What We Offer
•	A warm, supportive team and a relaxed island work environment
•	Stable hours (30-40 per week) with a regular roster
•	The chance to grow your hospitality skills in a busy, well-loved cafe
How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we'd love to meet you. Please email your CV and a short note about yourself to vacancies@bdc.im.

We can't wait to welcome the right person to the team!

Notes
Smoky Sam’s BBQ is looking for an enthusiastic and experienced Restaurant Supervisor to join our team.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about great food, excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for both our customers and our team. As a Restaurant Supervisor, you’ll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the restaurant and helping to make sure every customer has a fantastic experience.

You’ll be responsible for supervising the team during shifts, ensuring the restaurant is running smoothly and maintaining our high standards of service, cleanliness and food quality. You’ll lead by example, support and motivate team members, and help create a friendly and welcoming environment.

The ideal person will have previous experience in a restaurant, hospitality or supervisory role, although we’re also happy to consider someone with the right attitude, personality and willingness to learn. You’ll need to be confident communicating with both customers and staff, able to stay calm and organised during busy periods, and comfortable taking responsibility when required.

You’ll help with opening and closing the restaurant, managing shifts, supporting the team during busy services, dealing with customer queries and resolving any issues professionally. You’ll also work closely with management to ensure company standards and procedures are followed.

We believe our team is just as important as the food we serve. We’re looking for someone who is reliable, approachable, hardworking and enjoys being part of a team. If you’re someone who takes pride in your work and wants to help us continue providing great food and great service, we’d love to hear from you.
 Please send a copy of your CV and a small bit about yourself and why you would be a great fit at Smoky Sam's to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

Notes
As a Kitchen Porter, you’ll be an important part of keeping the kitchen running smoothly. You’ll work closely with our chefs and kitchen team to make sure everything is clean, organised and ready for service.

Your main responsibilities will include keeping the kitchen, equipment and work areas clean and tidy, washing dishes and kitchen equipment, helping with deliveries and putting stock away, keeping the pot wash area organised and supporting the chefs with general kitchen tasks when required. You’ll also help maintain our high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food safety throughout the kitchen.

We’re looking for someone who is hardworking, reliable and takes pride in keeping things clean and organised. You’ll need to be comfortable working in a busy kitchen environment and able to work well as part of a team. Hospitality or kitchen experience is preferred but isn’t essential, as the right attitude and willingness to learn are just as important to us.

Smoky Sam’s can be a fast-paced environment, especially during busy services, so you’ll need to be able to work under pressure, keep a positive attitude and be willing to get stuck in wherever needed.

We’re proud of our team and believe that every role in the kitchen is important. If you’re looking for a role where you can learn, develop your skills and become part of a friendly and hardworking team, we’d love to hear from you. 
Please email a copy of your CV to smokysamsbbq@gmail.com

We are looking for a Trainee IT & Print Engineer to join our team and develop a career within IT, print technology and technical services. This is a varied, hands-on role that offers the opportunity to learn from experienced professionals whilst gaining valuable technical skills and industry-recognised training.

No previous engineering experience is required. We are looking for someone with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine interest in technology.

What you will be doing:

Preparing and configuring printers and other devices before customer installation.
Delivering and installing equipment across the Isle of Man.
Supporting toner and consumables management for customers.
Assisting with the preparation and deployment of laptops and Apple devices.
Receiving, checking and organising stock within the warehouse.
Supporting inventory control and stocktake activities.
Learning our service desk and ticket management systems.
Providing excellent customer service both on-site and over the phone.

Typical working hours are a 37.5-hour week Monday to Friday.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
A keen interest in IT and technology.
Good practical and problem-solving skills.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
A customer-focused approach.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Ideally a full driving licence.

What we offer:

Full training and ongoing support.
Manufacturer training with leading technology providers.
Opportunity to attend specialist training courses in the UK.
Exposure to a wide range of IT and print technologies.
Genuine career progression into technical engineering roles.
A varied role where no two days are the same.

This role would suit a college leaver, someone looking to start a career in IT or engineering, or an individual with customer service or technical experience who is looking for a new challenge.
