Are you an experienced Software Engineer looking to help deliver high-quality digital and data solutions within a modern technology environment?

IFGL is seeking a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team and play a key role in the development, support and continuous improvement of our digital services, data platforms and business-critical applications. Reporting to the Engineering Team Lead, you will work closely with Architecture, Product and Delivery teams to design, build and maintain secure, scalable and reliable technology solutions that support our business objectives and technology strategy. This hands-on role offers the opportunity to work with cloud technologies, modern engineering practices and data-driven solutions whilst contributing to the ongoing evolution of our technology estate.

The main duties for this role are:
Deliver secure, scalable and reliable digital solutions, including data-centric applications, services and APIs, that meet business requirements and provide sustainable business value.
Design, optimise and support databases, data models and data services to ensure data quality, accessibility, performance and operational resilience.
Implement cloud-based and hybrid technology solutions that align with architectural standards, security requirements and long-term platform objectives.
Translate architectural designs and business requirements into robust technical solutions, ensuring consistency with engineering standards and best practice.
Improve engineering quality and delivery efficiency through automation, testing, CI/CD pipelines and the continuous enhancement of development practices.
Maintain service availability and operational stability through effective support, incident resolution and problem management activities.
Keep technical knowledge current by monitoring emerging technologies and engineering practices, identifying opportunities to improve organisational capability and delivery outcomes.

Please visit https://www.ifg-ltd.com/careers/ for the full job advert.

If you or you know someone who is interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com

Our client seeks a Senior Test Analyst to join their team. Key Responsibilities: Designing and executing functional and regression tests. Collaborating with change teams (BA/PM), development, and the business, to align testing with business & project objectives. Identifying, planning and implementing the test approach across BAU and project workstreams. Monitoring estimates against actuals, escalating potential slippage and providing workable options for mitigation. Monitoring and reporting on test results, creating & maintaining reporting dashboards, and producing completion reports for stakeholder approval. Adhering to testing strategy, processes & procedures to facilitate governance. Maintaining accurate documentation and artefacts for audit and governance purposes Designing, maintaining re-useable regression tests following internal standards, supporting test execution where needed to ensure deadlines are achieved. Developing own knowledge of automation technology and practice, to facilitate a shift-left/automation first approach. Coordination & support of UAT/BVT testing activities. Performance management, training & and support of direct reports. Key Skills and Experience: Minimum 3 years of testing experience. Excellent understanding of testing principles, techniques and methodologies. Strong analytical & problem-solving skills, attention to detail and commitment to quality. ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing. Experience of test automation is an advantage. Excellent communication, collaboration & leadership skills. Experience with using Gherkin syntax for test case design. Proven track record of delivering to tight deadlines. Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular would be desirable. Experience in people management is an advantage, although training will be given to the right candidate. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience in software testing and develop your leadership, technical and analytical skills. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16642

Our client seeks a Data Manager to join their team. To bridge the gap between technical IT teams and business managers by transforming raw data into actionable intelligence, ensuring the organisation's data is accurate, secure and effectively managed to support business decision making. Key Skills &  Experience: Usually degree educated in IT, Computer Science or statistical methods, with relevant experience. Advanced proficiency in programming languages and database systems like SQL, Python, Oracle. Solid understanding of data modelling / warehousing concepts and modern enterprise data architecture principles. Knowledge of ETL development and Data Pipeline orchestration using Apache Kafka & SSISSSAS Tabular Model development, DAX calculations/optimization, and Kimball-style dimensional data modelling (Star/Snowflake schemas). Data Visualization: Experience utilizing platforms such Power BI & SSRS, or similar BI software such as Tableau. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to evaluate integrity and interpret inconsistencies across large, complex datasets. Manage and develop a small, high performing data team, including mentoring, 1:1s and continuous improvement initiatives. Proven experience in a similar role. Experience analysing complex data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to support business decision-making. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver effective solutions. High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Working closely with the Directors, the successful candidate will develop governance and risk management frameworks, coordinate due diligence, AML, KYC and onboarding activities, support financial governance and strategic business projects, maintain relationships with international partners and professional advisers, and contribute to commercial reporting, operational improvement and organisational performance across multiple jurisdictions.
Applicants must hold a degree or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Audit, Compliance, Governance or a related discipline, together with significant experience in governance, compliance, audit, financial controls, regulatory reporting or operational management within an international or other complex multi stakeholder environment. Candidates should possess strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, sound professional judgement, high ethical standards and integrity, and the ability to manage multiple projects, confidential information and stakeholder relationships effectively. Professional qualifications in Accounting, Audit, Compliance or Governance, together with experience of AML, KYC, due diligence and corporate governance, would be advantageous.
This is a key strategic role within a growing international business, offering the opportunity to work with international entrepreneurs, professional advisers and cross border commercial projects, while contributing to the continued growth and international expansion of Fresh Business Ventures Ltd.

Desirable - Working towards or willing to pursue a recognised project management qualification e.g. PRINCE2 Foundation, AgilePM.

The successful candidate will need a full UK driving licence as the role involves working at different sites.

Notes
We are looking for a results focused Manager to join our Restructuring Advisory team at FRP Advisory (Isle of Man) Ltd. You will work on a wide range of assignments across both advisory and formal engagements. You will take a lead role in managing a portfolio of insolvency cases, including, liquidations, receiverships, CVL’s and MVL’s ensuring statutory compliance whilst being responsible for stakeholder engagement throughout.

You will manage a portfolio of insolvency cases, overseeing case progression from appointment through to closure while ensuring compliance with relevant insolvency legislation. The role requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and lead teams across concurrent projects, delegating work effectively, reviewing outputs, and providing technical guidance where required. You will liaise with a range of stakeholders including directors, creditors, legal advisors, accountants and agents, undertake investigations into financial and legal matters, and prepare high-quality reports and presentations for both internal and external audiences. In addition, you will support the development of team members, contribute to training initiatives, process improvements and technical updates, and apply strong analytical, problem-solving and commercial skills to identify risks, develop practical solutions and recognise opportunities to support client needs and business growth. A balance of strategic thinking, attention to detail and strong leadership capability will be essential for success in the role.

Copilot said:

We are looking for a degree-educated professional who holds a recognised accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA or ICAS, and has demonstrable experience managing insolvency and advisory cases. The successful candidate will possess strong technical knowledge of insolvency legislation and procedures, coupled with excellent report-writing and communication skills. They will be commercially aware, able to identify opportunities and understand client needs, while also being capable of managing competing priorities and delivering high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, analytical approach and the ability to exercise sound judgement under pressure are essential.

You can apply to the role using this link: https://smrtr.io/zZV-x

Notes
Are you a skilled Vehicle Technician looking to take the next step in your career? We are Nissan's authorised service & repair workshop on the Isle of Man, and we are looking for a talented, motivated, and customer-focused individual to join our dynamic workshop team in Ballasalla.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work with one of the world's leading automotive brands, utilising the latest diagnostic equipment and manufacturer training. Whether you are working on routine servicing or complex diagnostics and repairs, you will play a vital role in keeping our customers safely on the road.

In this role, you will be responsible for carrying out servicing, maintenance, and repairs on Nissan vehicles to the highest manufacturer standards. A core part of the position involves performing diagnostic work using Nissan's specialist CONSULT diagnostic equipment, completing warranty repairs, and supporting technical service campaigns. You will conduct thorough vehicle health checks and communicate your findings clearly to our service advisors, while proactively identifying any faults or emerging issues during inspection. You will also be expected to maintain a clean, safe, and well-organised workshop environment at all times, complete job cards and workshop documentation accurately, and keep your technical knowledge current through Nissan's ongoing manufacturer training programmes and technical bulletins.

We are seeking a candidate who holds a recognised automotive qualification such as NVQ Level 2 or 3, City & Guilds, or an equivalent accreditation, along with proven hands-on experience as a Vehicle Technician in either a franchised or independent workshop setting. You should have solid experience working with modern vehicle diagnostic systems, and whilst Nissan or other manufacturer-brand training is desirable, it is by no means essential as full training will be provided. Above all, we are looking for someone who takes pride in the quality of their work, communicates well with colleagues and customers alike, holds a full valid Isle of Man driving licence, and has the drive and initiative to perform equally well working independently or as part of a close-knit team.

To apply for this position, please send your CV and a covering letter to: gm@athol.co.im

Notes
Our Isle of Man office is looking for an individual with strong interpersonal skills who enjoys variety in their working day, to join us as Receptionist & Facilities Support on a full-time, permanent basis to assist the current team. 

This is a dual role, working predominantly on our Reception Desk but providing facilities support as and when required in a flexible capacity. 

Due to local immigration restrictions, we are only able to consider candidates who are local Manx residents

As Receptionist, you will be required to:

Operate the office switchboard 
Provide reception ‘meeting and greeting’ services to clients and office visitors
Organise client meeting room booking requests and prepare rooms for meetings
Provide routine office administration to assist the wider business
Book taxis and local accommodation for staff
Liaise with external office services e.g. couriers and receive small deliveries from suppliers or clients
Manage the office equipment loan stock for staff, for example portable printers and scanners
Logging and following up on Helpdesk tickets

Our Receptionist is the main contact point for our business and will be dealing with clients and suppliers and liaising with our staff. You will be dealing with a wide variety of activities, ranging from managing the reception desk and switchboard to organising meeting rooms, co-ordinating taxi bookings and assisting with administrative tasks.

In providing Facilities support, you will be required to assist with:

Replenishing and maintaining the kitchen areas on each floor, and vending machine in Staff Room
Collecting and distributing fruit and milk deliveries
Monitoring shredding bins on each floor and arranging collection
Maintaining photocopier and stationary areas on each floor – distributing supplies and consumables
Maintaining oversight and ensuring appropriate stock levels for vending machines and water towers
Liaising with third-party suppliers relating to PPM, Air Conditioning, ad-hoc R&M requirements and cleaning contracts
Ordering Supplies for the kitchens, vending machines, printers and stationary

Candidates do not need to have prior office experience to succeed in this role, however they should have strong communication skills and a proactive approach to working. 

Working hours are 08:45am - 5pm Monday to Friday 

To thrive in this role, you will also need:

Logical approach to task management 
Strong interpersonal skills 
Self-motivation and ability to use own initiative 
Readiness to work flexibly outside of core business hours (9am - 5:15pm) to support office based events, as required 
Intermediate knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite of programmes, with emphasis on Outlook
Language requirements - strong spoken, listening and written English
Previous experience in office facilities would be advantageous although not essential
Previous experience working on a Reception Desk within the financial services industry is preferable but not mandatory

To apply for this role please email Khamon@kpmg.com or call 01534608403

Notes
We have a permanent position available within the Ardan Customer Services Team. 

We are looking for someone with experience in financial services, ideally with an understanding of customer due diligence, AML  requirements and portfolio servicing; however we are a supportive team who will provide full training and guidance. 

Reporting to the Investment Services Manager, this role will be the point of contact for support and administration assistance to our Brokers, Ardan sales force and regional offices. 

Key responsibilities will include:

•	Client portfolio maintenance and ongoing servicing on the CRM system and the Ardan Investment platform, including web support. 
•	Process withdrawals/surrenders while ensuring a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 
•	Provide support to Sales force, Brokers on our processes and operational procedures in a professional, confident and timely manner. 
•	Manage customer servicing requests accurately, proactively and in accordance with procedures, priorities and service standards. 
•	Develop and maintain knowledge of Ardan products, systems and processes to support both routine and more complex customer enquiries. 
•	Ensure all activities are completed in accordance with regulatory requirements, internal controls and company standards. 
•	Identify and escalate risks, issues or concerns appropriately to help protect customers and the business.
•	Capture, maintain, and accurately record management information (MI) data, ensuring data integrity, completeness, and compliance with organisational standards.

To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following skills and experience:

•	Ideally 2 years’ financial services experience
•	Customer service experience within financial services or a similar professional environment. 
•	Strong organisational and time management skills. 
•	Ability to prioritise competing workloads and adapt to changing priorities. 
•	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 
•	Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. 
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
•	Knowledge of customer due diligence, AML requirements or financial services products would be advantageous, but is not essential as full training will be provided.
•	Positive person who adds to the team culture by sharing knowledge and supporting continuous improvement initiatives
Our Values
We are looking for individuals who demonstrate our values of:
•	CARE – putting customers and colleagues first.
•	COMMERCIALITY – delivering value and effective solutions.
•	EMPOWERMENT – taking ownership and making a positive difference.
•	ONE TEAM – working together to achieve shared success.

If you are interested in applying for this position, please forward a current CV with a covering letter to careers@ifg-ltd.com 
Closing date for this vacancy will be 21 August 2026.

We are delighted to be working with an established specialist investment management firm who are seeking an experienced Compliance Officer / MLRO to join their team on a part-time basis, approximately 2.5 days per week. This is an excellent opportunity for a compliance professional with investment management experience to take responsibility for a key regulatory function within an established business. The successful candidate will be responsible for the Isle of Man compliance function, ensuring the business continues to meet its regulatory obligations. The firm is regulated by the Isle of Man Financial Services Authority (IOMFSA) as an Investment Manager and also operates within a US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulated environment. The role will focus primarily on Isle of Man regulatory requirements, with external specialist support already in place for US SEC compliance matters. Previous SEC experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Key Responsibilities: Act as Compliance Officer and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) for Isle of Man regulated activities. Maintain and oversee the compliance framework in line with IOMFSA requirements. Provide compliance advice and guidance to the business. Review, update and maintain compliance policies, procedures and controls. Monitor regulatory developments and support the implementation of relevant changes. Oversee AML/CFT obligations and ensure appropriate controls remain in place. Support regulatory reporting and compliance monitoring activities. Work alongside external advisers supporting US SEC compliance requirements. Key Skills and Experience: Previous experience within investment management compliance. Experience working within a regulated financial services environment. Experience acting as a Compliance Officer and/or MLRO. Strong understanding of AML/CFT requirements and regulatory frameworks. The ability to work independently and manage a broad compliance remit. Strong communication skills with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders. Experience within asset management, hedge funds or investment firms would be highly desirable.

Main Responsibilities: please see Job Description for more information on responsibilities
•	Building warm, trusting relationships with children and young people and being a positive role model in their everyday lives.
•	Providing consistent, nurturing care and supporting the daily life of the home, from mealtimes and routines to school, activities and appointments.
•	Safeguarding and promoting the welfare of every child and young person and helping to keep them safe.
•	Supporting each young person’s care plan, encouraging their education, health, interests and independence, and working alongside families and other agencies.
•	Keeping good records and working within the home’s policies and the standards that apply to children’s homes on the Isle of Man.
Main Requirements (for full details check the job description and person specification):
•	A genuine commitment to children and young people, and the warmth, patience and resilience to support them well.
•	A willingness to work towards a recognised Level 3 qualification in residential childcare, which we will support you to achieve.
•	The flexibility to work a rota including days, evenings, weekends, bank holidays and sleep-ins.
•	The ability to build trusting relationships while keeping professional boundaries, to work well in a team and to keep accurate records.
•	You must be at least 21 years of age, in line with the requirement for working directly with children and young people in a residential setting.
•	A satisfactory enhanced DBS check with a children’s barred list check, which we will arrange.

To Apply:
If this sounds like the kind of work you have been looking for, we would love to hear from you. You do not need to meet every point to apply. If you have the right values and a genuine commitment to children and young people, please do get in touch.

•	Please copy and paste this link into your web browser: https://webrecru.it/ZPdS3, then click the “Apply Now” link below and fill out our digital application form
•	Closing Date: Wednesday 26th August 2026, 23:59. Interviews will take place on a rolling basis so please apply early.

For direct queries, or if you would like to discuss any aspect of the role or the selection process, please email: Clare.Lawson@family-action.org.uk

Our client seeks a Site Manager to join their team. You will be the go-to person on-site, responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards. You'll manage teams, liaise with clients and subcontractors, and keep everything running like a well-oiled (but friendly) machine. Key Responsibilities: Manage and supervise site operations from groundworks to completion. Lead Health & Safety standards at scale, embedding compliance and best practice across all site operations. Oversee and coordinate a high volume of subcontractors, suppliers and on-site workers. Take full responsibility for day-to-day site operations, supporting the directors and managing programme, budget, and risk. Monitor progress, manage timelines, and report regularly to the Directors. Conduct regular site inspections and quality checks, liaising with local authorities and other stakeholders. Resolve any issues or delays that arise on-site. Maintain site records and ensure documentation is up to date. Essential Requirements: SMSTS/SSSTS Certification. CITB. First Aid at Work. Key Skills and Experience: Proven experience as a Site Manager on large-scale residential or commercial projects. Strong knowledge of building regulations and site health & safety. Experience managing multiple subcontractors and direct staff. Ability to take full operational responsibility, working autonomously in a growing business. Excellent leadership, organisational, and communication skills. Ability to read and interpret construction drawings. Calm under pressure and solutions-focused. Full clean driving licence. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16730

Translating requirements and issues clearly back to the product and development teams. Supporting implementation, onboarding, training and user adoption. Ongoing focus, support for driving RPI/CPI upside and cost savings to aid P&L. Cash flow management, supplier focus. Centralised Renewals Management. Someone who is ethically focused and can provide an impartial and balanced view. You must be comfortable working in an agile and rapidly changing environment across multiple business and supplier verticals. Ability to run RfP processes. Ideally a minimum of 5/10 years in a commercial/procurement role. Business experience is key as is being a go getter, someone who is keen to learn and to broaden their experience etc.

Role Profile: This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of legal matters, work closely with the business, and play a hands-on role in shaping how legal supports a growing international company. This position is suited to a proactive and detail-oriented lawyer who is comfortable working independently, taking accountability, and driving continuous improvement in legal processes and documentation. Key responsibilities: Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including SaaS/software licensing, partnerships, and supplier contracts. Act as a key legal contact for business stakeholders, providing clear, pragmatic, and commercially focused advice. Take ownership of legal support for designated business areas. Identify and implement improvements to legal processes, workflows, and ways of working. Develop and maintain contract templates, playbooks, and internal guidance. Collaborate with a multi-jurisdictional legal team. Manage external counsel and support disputes where required. Monitor relevant legal and regulatory developments in the gaming and technology sectors. Support strategic business initiatives, including new product development. Key Skills & Experience: 4-6 years PQE (post qualification experience) as a solicitor, advocate or equivalent required - this is a guideline so if you feel that you are suitable, please still apply. Strong grounding in commercial and contract law. Experience in the gaming industry/software development industry is advantageous but not essential. Ability to work independently, take ownership, and manage priorities. Experience improving legal processes, templates, or ways of working is highly desirable. Excellent drafting, negotiation, and communication skills. Ability to provide practical, business-focused advice in a clear and concise manner. Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively across different jurisdictions and cultures. A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and interest in the gaming/technology space. Experience working with legal technology tools (e.g. CLM systems, document automation) is advantageous. Interest in leveraging AI and legal technology to improve legal service delivery and efficiency is desirable.

Our client seeks a Test Lead to join their team. Role Profile: You will take responsibility for leading testing activities to ensure quality and reliability across technology landscape. This role ensures adherence to testing standards, collaborates with development and change teams, and drives continuous improvement to deliver secure, high-quality releases. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead software testing teams on a variety of challenging and interesting projects. Key Responsibilities: Defining and executing test plans that ensure comprehensive coverage and quality, adhering to departments strategy and processes and implementing test standards and best practices across teams. Collaborating with Development, Change and business teams to align testing with delivery objectives. Proactively helping with testing to ensure team deadlines are achieved. Monitoring and reporting on test results, identifying trends and driving improvements, continuous improvement through adoption of new tools, techniques and automation opportunities. Managing test environments and data to support accurate and efficient testing. Coordination and support of UAT/BVT testing activities. Performance management and support of direct reports. Key Skills & Experience: ISTQB Foundation certificate in Software Testing is essential, ISTQB Advanced level is desirable. Minimum 5 years experience of testing, with at least 3 years in a senior/lead role. Experience of the Finance domain, and Life & Pensions in particular, is an advantage. Experience of test automation is an advantage. Excellent planning and organisational skills, able to manage multiple workloads concurrently. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, ability to engage positively with & gain support from senior management/stakeholders. Ability to work collaboratively, or on your own initiative, and deliver to tight deadlines. Strong understanding of Gherkin syntax, peer reviews and formal reviews. A genuine interest in technology and software testing. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16646

Self-Employed Sales Agent – Automotive Lubricants - Part time

We are looking for a friendly, professional and motivated self-employed sales agent to promote and sell Forté lubricants—an established, market-leading range of vehicle additives and workshop consumables—to customers throughout the automotive aftermarket, including workshops, dealerships and retail outlets across the Isle of Man.

This flexible, part-time opportunity would be ideal for someone who already represents a complementary, non-competing brand or works in a similar sales role. You will manage your own time and diary, making it easy to fit the role around your existing commitments. For the right person, there is potential to develop this into a full-time opportunity.

You will be part of a friendly, relaxed and supportive working environment while retaining the independence to develop your own customer relationships and sales territory.

What we offer:
A generous 20% commission rate. 
Uncapped earning potential. 
Realistically achievable bonus structure. 
Flexible, part-time hours. 
Freedom to manage your own diary and workload. 
The opportunity to develop the role into a full-time business. 
A friendly, relaxed and supportive working relationship. 
An established range of quality products. 

About you:
Friendly, confident and comfortable speaking with customers. 
Self-motivated, reliable and well organised. 
Smart and professional in appearance. 
Contactable during normal office hours. 
Able to work independently and manage your own appointments. 
Previous sales experience would be beneficial, particularly within the automotive, workshop, motor trade or a related sector. 
An existing network of relevant customers or a complementary agency would be an advantage. 

Essential requirements:
A full, valid driving licence. 
Your own suitable transport. 
Secure and appropriate storage space for holding stock. 
The ability to operate on a self-employed basis. 

This is a self-employed, commission-based opportunity and does not include a guaranteed salary. Your earnings will be based on your sales, with no upper limit on what you can earn.

If you are enthusiastic, professional and interested in developing a flexible sales opportunity around your existing commitments, we would be pleased to hear from you.
To apply for this role please call 	07858634837

Do you love the smell of freshly baked bread in the morning? Are you passionate about food and thrive in a fast-paced environment?

As a key member of our morning team, you'll help us bring smiles (and bread!) to our customers. From packing up loaves to prepping for the next bake, you'll be an essential part of the bakery buzz.

Notes
Bidvest Noonan is seeking reliable and professional Casual Security Officers to join our team at the Isle of Man Courts of Justice. This is a zero-hour contract position, providing cover on an as-required basis, making it ideal for individuals seeking flexible work opportunities.
About the Role
Working within a secure and professional environment, you will play a vital role in maintaining the safety and security of the Courts of Justice building, its staff, visitors, and users.
Using an airport-style security screening approach, your duties will include:
Monitoring access points to the Courts of Justice building.
Conducting security searches of persons and property before authorising entry.
Carrying out regular internal and external foot patrols.
Monitoring visitor numbers and maintaining accurate records and reports.
Operating and monitoring the building's CCTV systems.
Identifying and responding appropriately to disruptive or escalating behaviour.
Providing excellent customer service whilst maintaining a safe and secure environment.
Developing positive working relationships with court staff, service users, and our client.
What We're Looking For
The successful candidate will be:
Professional, reliable, and trustworthy.
Calm and patient under pressure.
An excellent communicator with strong interpersonal skills.
Confident dealing with members of the public.
Flexible and available to work shifts at short notice when required.
Able to work independently and as part of a wider team.
Previous security experience is desirable but not essential, as full training will be provided.
Training
Successful candidates will receive comprehensive training, including:
Emergency First Aid at Work.
Automated External Defibrillation (AED).
Conflict Management and De-escalation.
Fire Marshal Training.
Control and Restraint.
Working Pattern
Casual 0-hour contract.
Monday to Friday shifts available as required.
Weekend on-call opportunities available.
Hours offered according to operational needs and cover requirements.
How to Apply
To apply, please submit your CV and a brief covering letter.
For further information, please contact:
Liam Otten 
Email: Liam.Otten@bidvestnoonan.com
Telephone: 01624 685264
Bidvest Noonan is committed to providing equal opportunities and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Our client seeks a Temporary Retail Sales Consultant to join their team and deliver an efficient and professional service to customers seeking information, purchasing assistance, and after-sales support for a full range of products and services. This is a part time role for 30 hours a week and will be a temporary contract for approximately 4 months. You may be required to work selected Thursday evenings and Sunday day shifts during the Christmas trading period (1 November to 31 December). Key Responsibilities: Present an efficient and professional sales service for all customers. Always greet customers with a smile. Provide customers with honest and clear information. Clearly provide all the information a customer needs to make informed decision relating to their needs. Make sure all customers leave with a complete and working service. Demonstrate and sell products and services. Attend daily staff briefings before opening. Fully competent in the use of the computerised systems and other applications relevant to the sales process after training. Provide on-going support for all products and services available, by means of face to face, email, telephone contact, and strive to resolve all customer queries/complaints. Assist if required, in training of new members of the Retail team. Attend or partake in any training that may be required. Be aware of the commercial requirements of the company and the retail department in particular. Work to meet personal and group sales targets and process all orders within targets set by the Company. Key Skills and Experience: Previous sales experience. Appreciation of the importance of customer service. Ability to deal with difficult customers. Enthusiasm for new technology. Ability to deal with and communicate effectively with customers and staff at all levels. Knowledge of Microsoft Office. An understanding of modern retail technology would be desirable. 
 If you have the required skills please apply online at searchandselect.com quoting reference number: 16756

Notes
Be part of something precise, impactful, and innovative.
Are you someone who enjoys hands-on work, thrives in a laboratory environment, and takes pride in doing things with accuracy and care? We’re looking for a Production Technician to join our team and play a key role in manufacturing high-quality chromatography products that support important scientific and commercial outcomes.
This is more than just a production role — it’s an opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement, process optimisation, and innovation in a regulated, high-performing environment.

What you’ll be doing - You’ll be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure our products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Your responsibilities will include: Manufacturing chromatography products, intermediates, and base materials, Following established SOPs and production methods with precision, Recording production data accurately and maintaining detailed documentation, Carrying out on-line quality control checks and identifying any anomalies early, Supporting process optimisation and improvement initiatives, Maintaining equipment and ensuring a clean, safe working environment
You’ll also contribute to: Improving processes and maximising yields, Writing and updating SOPs and production methods, Sharing knowledge and supporting the development of colleagues
We’re looking for someone who is practical, detail-focused, and proactive, with a genuine interest in laboratory-based manufacturing.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are: A strong team player with good communication skills, Highly organised with excellent attention to detail, Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, A natural problem solver who can spot issues early, Able to follow processes accurately while also contributing ideas for improvement
Desirable experience: A-levels or degree in a scientific discipline, Experience in regulated manufacturing (ideally chemical or similar environments) Familiarity with laboratory equipment and processes
This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role where no two days are quite the same. You can expect: A physically active role involving standing, lifting, and equipment operation, A structured environment with a strong focus on quality and safety, 24/7 shift patterns supporting continuous operations
You’ll be part of a collaborative team where your contribution directly impacts product quality, operational success, and continuous improvement. We value curiosity, precision, and teamwork — and we’re always looking for ways to do things better.
If you’re looking for a role where you can build your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and be part of a supportive and driven team, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply using the following link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8139650-production-chemist-astrea

Be part of something precise, impactful, and innovative.
Are you someone who enjoys hands-on work, thrives in a laboratory environment, and takes pride in doing things with accuracy and care? We’re looking for a Production Technician to join our team and play a key role in manufacturing high-quality chromatography products that support important scientific and commercial outcomes.
This is more than just a production role — it’s an opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement, process optimisation, and innovation in a regulated, high-performing environment.

What you’ll be doing - You’ll be at the heart of our manufacturing operations, helping ensure our products are produced safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Your responsibilities will include: Manufacturing chromatography products, intermediates, and base materials, Following established SOPs and production methods with precision, Recording production data accurately and maintaining detailed documentation, Carrying out on-line quality control checks and identifying any anomalies early, Supporting process optimisation and improvement initiatives, Maintaining equipment and ensuring a clean, safe working environment
You’ll also contribute to: Improving processes and maximising yields, Writing and updating SOPs and production methods, Sharing knowledge and supporting the development of colleagues
We’re looking for someone who is practical, detail-focused, and proactive, with a genuine interest in laboratory-based manufacturing.
You’ll thrive in this role if you are: A strong team player with good communication skills, Highly organised with excellent attention to detail, Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, A natural problem solver who can spot issues early, Able to follow processes accurately while also contributing ideas for improvement
Desirable experience: A-levels or degree in a scientific discipline, Experience in regulated manufacturing (ideally chemical or similar environments) Familiarity with laboratory equipment and processes
This is a hands-on, laboratory-based role where no two days are quite the same. You can expect: A physically active role involving standing, lifting, and equipment operation, A structured environment with a strong focus on quality and safety, 24/7 shift patterns supporting continuous operations
You’ll be part of a collaborative team where your contribution directly impacts product quality, operational success, and continuous improvement. We value curiosity, precision, and teamwork — and we’re always looking for ways to do things better.
If you’re looking for a role where you can build your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and be part of a supportive and driven team, we’d love to hear from you. Please apply using the following link - https://biotage-1708019070.teamtailor.com/jobs/8139650-production-chemist-astrea
